The paired area nearly completely cancels within Miami MSA33100, whose independent2020 land control estimates near-zero exposure. Retain shapes, prior repairs, published PIT/HIC and membership without count allocation; revisit individual pre-2012 CoC analysis. Neither legal nor GIS dates establish a count-scope date, and resident estimates do not locate shelters or encampments. Both population vintages use2020 water linework.
